The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement to your daily driving experience.  Safety and security are paramount in the Camry SE. Ambient features like illuminate entry, overhead console, and front and rear reading lights create a welcoming environment for all passengers. Safety and control are foundational to this vehicle's design. An independent four-wheel suspension system, anti-roll bars front and rear, and electronic stability control work together to provide confident handling. The four-wheel disc braking system with ABS, combined with low tire pressure warning and occupant sensing airbags, reflects Toyota's commitment to occupant protection. Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off function and front fog lights improve visibility in varying conditions.  The black exterior is complemented by body-color bumpers, a roof rack with rails, and heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators. Variably intermittent wipers and delay-off headlights add thoughtful conveniences to everyday driving, while the spoiler contributes to the vehicle's balanced appearance.  Rated at 21 city MPG and 27 highway MPG, the 3.5L V6 delivers the power needed for real-world family driving while maintaining competitive fuel efficiency.
